### 18.1 What is outstanding [LUNI.18.1]

The cross-platform bit-exact golden vectors for tier-1 affine conversion
are not landed. `LUNI.2.7_float_repr_roundtrip` pins the current-state
float representation; the full `.dsc` factor-table vector lands with unit
factor emission.
